text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because Epiphaneia wasn't feeling well,
I decided to have her rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...?! Where is this...?
You are——... Me?!

The answer is: Nay! I am a vengeful spirit who has taken form
by borrowing your likeness—

text_block_list.name: Vengeful Spirit of a Bicycle
text_block_list.text: The ghost of the bicycle you rode and totaled in 30 minutes!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: The ghost of the bicycle I totaled within thirty minutes?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I remember now! When I was little,
they bought me a bicycle so I could try learning how to ride it, but—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I kept bumping into things until the brakes broke, and when I dragged it to the repair shop, the mechanic just silently shook his head... That bicycle!!

text_block_list.name: Vengeful Spirit of a Bicycle
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, that grudge is what granted me this form!
Now, how shall I vent this bitter resentment...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Regrets? You have regrets?!
You ought to clear them up! What kind of regrets are they?!

text_block_list.name: Vengeful Spirit of a Bicycle
text_block_list.text: Huh? Well, um... It's like, I kind of wanted to run a whole lot more...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I see, then let's go for a run right now!!
Come on!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"How about it? This is the route I've been running a lot lately!
Feels great to run here, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Vengeful Spirit of a Bicycle
text_block_list.text: "It certainly has a fine view—h-hmph...! As if my grudge could be cleared away by something like this!!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I see, then let's try going even further!
Keep up with me!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Look, bicycle! Isn't this view incredible!?

text_block_list.name: Vengeful Spirit of a Bicycle
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, the breeze feels so pleasant...
—Hmph, not yet! This is still not enough!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —Fufu. We've run in so many races together...! How about it? Did that clear away some of your regrets?

text_block_list.name: Vengeful Spirit of a Bicycle
text_block_list.text:
...Epiphaneia.
My true regret is...

text_block_list.name: Vengeful Spirit of a Bicycle
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to run to so many more places...
'together with you'—"

text_block_list.name: Vengeful Spirit of a Bicycle
text_block_list.text:
Surely, that was all there was to it.
...Heh, in my next life, I think I'll be a horseshoe.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: A bicycle, you—...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —A bicycle...!!
choice_data_list: Huh, what? Did you dream about riding a bicycle or something?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: A dream—I see, so it was just a dream...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I had a dream where I raced against a bicycle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Running alongside a bicycle" was certainly bizarre—
or so I thought, yet curiously, Epiphaneia's
expression was bright and clear.
